assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome
The symptoms are suggestive of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The symptoms are of a paroxysmal nature
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture and characterize the arrhythmic events
The service is medically necessary to document the intermittent cardiac events responsible for the patient's palpitations, lightheadedness, and syncope
The diagnosis is sick sinus syndrome
The diagnosis is unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The diagnosis code I49.5 is assigned
The diagnosis code I49.9 is assigned
The CPT code for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is 93229
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
Coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates advance approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines
The provider has the right to appeal this determination
A formal appeal should be submitted within the timeframe specified in the provider agreement
Supporting clinical documentation that justifies the medical necessity of the service should be included
Failure to adhere to these requirements may result in the finalization of this denial
